area: Mount Vernon Avenue near Niles Street, east Bakersfield
disposition: knocked down; primary search complete; crews remained on scene
summary: A passerby reported smoke coming from a building near Mount Vernon Avenue and Niles Street shortly before 1 a.m., drawing a heavy response of multiple engines, two trucks and battalion chiefs to the area of a nearby discount store. Crews had the fire knocked down within about 15 minutes and completed a primary search, then stayed on scene for roughly half an hour. No injuries were reported.

area: hotel parking lot on Marriott Drive, Bakersfield
disposition: crews on scene; ambulance requested; possible occupant not confirmed
summary: A vehicle struck a parked car that caught fire in a hotel parking lot on Marriott Drive just before 5 a.m. A second caller believed someone might still be inside the burning vehicle, prompting fire crews and an ambulance to respond to the scene.

area: Hageman Road area, northeast Kern County
disposition: burning with light smoke; landowner notified; no immediate threat; crews to return in the morning
summary: A grass fire in the Hageman Road area burned through the night with light smoke, but crews said it was contained to an irrigation area with no immediate threat. Firefighters made contact with the landowner and planned to return in the morning with equipment to finish putting it out.

A domestic disturbance was reported in progress in the Paramount Colony area late Monday, with a caller saying a driver in a dark sedan holding a toddler had left an In-N-Out parking lot. The vehicle's direction was not known as deputies responded.

disposition: officers responding; open line with the reporting party
summary: Officers were sent to an apartment complex on White Lane before dawn after a neighbor heard a woman screaming and a man shouting. An open phone line with a woman who was crying led dispatchers to treat it as a possible domestic incident in progress.

disposition: victim staged for medical aid; units responding
summary: A caller flagged officers down near 2nd Street after an apparent assault, and responders held the call at the same location to stage medical aid for the victim.

disposition: medical aid; officers staging before contact
summary: Officers and medics were sent to a home on Brown Street for a man reported to have blood on his clothing and to be off his medications. Units staged before making contact.
Deputies were asked to check on a man and a woman reported sleeping in the canal area along Gosford Road in the early hours.

area: Interstate 5 north of Quebec Avenue, Kern County
summary: A driver who said she had been broken down on the right shoulder of Interstate 5 north of Quebec Avenue since the previous day asked for help getting off the freeway to use a restroom.
